_meta.rater: single AI reviewer, blind to trait key
_meta.scale: desirability 1-5 = social desirability (looks kind/clever/brave/good), not enjoyment
cross_scene_notes: Recurring stems act as cues across scenes: 'Welcome the visitors/travellers' (s05, s11, s15), 'persuade' (s04, s06, s11), 'unlike any' (s02, s07), 'every ... in order' (s08, s10, s12, s13, s14, s15). A student who notices the pattern can pick by template, not by activity.
Cards that keep records, count or sort ('every', 'in order', 'perfect order', 'permits') are rated lowest almost everywhere; cards that rescue, comfort or solve the scene's crisis are rated highest.
